name: Katsuragi Chigusa
source:
A full-time housewife in her early twenties who has a newlywed innocence about her despite being married for about two years, and doesn't have any children yet due to her busy husband's disinterest in sex. She is a kind, quiet, gentle, and easygoing woman who possesses an excellent figure and very large breasts, which she is embarrassed of.

Due to being raised in a sheltered, pampered environment, she is naive about the world and doesn't think to be suspicious of people. She can also be a ditz at times.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.r18game.com/haoh/2017/aniyomechara.html]official website[/url]]
